title: v0 Review 2026: Pricing, Features, and Honest Verdict
summary: Vercel's v0 generates best-in-class React UI, but it falls short on backend depth, billing, and non-technical usability. Here's why Blink is the more complete platform for serious builders.
body_markdown: Blink. It covers v0's three biggest gaps natively, a full backend included instead of the weakest in the category, native Stripe subscription billing instead of none at all, and no-code usability instead of requiring an existing project and a developer, and it's a more complete platform overall: native mobile apps, growth tooling, and human support are all things v0 doesn't offer at any tier. More options are ranked in our[v0 alternatives](https://blink.new/blog/v0-alternatives) roundup.
